question: Where is the closest maritime museum close by Shop One, Rochester, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE museum = TRUE AND poi_name ILIKE '%maritime%' ORDER BY ST_Distance( pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shop One%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rochester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
